extraction_notes: MMSZ4685 VZ range at IZT = 0.05 A is 3.42 V minimum, 3.60 V nominal, and 3.78 V maximum at TA = 25 degC.
The datasheet electrical table does not publish ZZT or ZZK values for MMSZ4685.
Figures on p. 3 are power derating and transient thermal impedance curves, not usable zener electrical curves.
omission_reason: No usable electrical device curve is published: the only figures are power derating and transient thermal impedance. Capacitance and reverse-recovery data are not provided.
